taste_gap: Supply leg only. Over-index D is 0 because it was not recomputed. This is not the published Taste Gap Index.
weights: Stated priors in footfall.WEIGHTS, not fitted to these outcomes.

sources.name: Transportation Network Providers - Trips (2018 - 2022)
sources.weekend: Each Saturday and Sunday in 2022, by trip end timestamp. A Saturday evening trip is also in the evening series.

sources.name: Divvy Trips
sources.measure: Trip ends grouped by station coordinate, then summed into the community area that contains the station.
sources.note: This portal file ends 2020-01-21. 2019 is its last full year and is before the backtest window.

sources.name: CTA - Ridership - 'L' Station Entries - Daily Totals
sources.measure: Sum of station entries (rides). Stations located with dataset 8pix-ypme and placed in a community area.
sources.note: Entries at L stations outside the 77 community areas. The system continues into the suburbs, so those rides are not a Chicago community-area count.
